cards.front: Dale el libro a tu hermano.
cards.back: Give your brother the book.

cards.front: Les voy a dar la clase mañana por la mañana.
cards.back: I'm giving them the class tomorrow morning.

cards.front: ¿Siempre das dinero a los músicos cuando los ves tocar por la calle?
cards.back: Do you always give musicians money when you see them playing in the street?

cards.front: Ella no le está dando la entrada a tu hermano.
cards.back: She isn't giving the ticket to your brother.

cards.front: Da mucho dinero a un partido político, ¡pero no sé a cuál!
cards.back: He gives a lot of his money to a political party... but I don't know which one!

cards.front: ¿Por qué no le das las flores a ella?
cards.back: Why don't you give the flowers to her?

cards.front: ¿Por qué se lo estás dando a ellas?
cards.back: Why are you giving it to them?

cards.front: ¡Dánoslo!
cards.back: Give it to us!

cards.front: ¡No me lo des a mí!
cards.back: Don't give it to me!

cards.front: ¿Nos podéis dar vuestras opiniones al final de la sesión?
cards.back: Can you give us your opinions at the end of the session?

cards.front: Está dando tu ropa a sus hermanos menores.
cards.back: She's giving your clothes to her younger brothers.

cards.front: No les des ninguno de nuestros secretos.
cards.back: Don't give them any of our secrets.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no nos las das?
cards.back: Why don't you give them to us?

cards.front: ¿Os los puedo dar más tarde?
cards.back: Can I give them to you later?

cards.front: Suelo dárselas a ellos al final de la semana.
cards.back: I usually give them to them at the end of the week.

cards.front: Dar a luz es una experiencia maravillosa.
cards.back: Giving birth is a wonderful experience.

cards.front: Dar a luz es una experiencia fantástica.
cards.back: Giving birth is a fantastic experience.

cards.front: Dar a luz es una experiencia alucinante, para algunas.
cards.back: Giving birth is an amazing experience, for some.

cards.front: Te llamaré cuando llegue.
cards.back: I'll give you a ring when I get there.

cards.front: Sí, por favor, llámame cuando llegues.
cards.back: Yes, please. Give me a call when you get there.

cards.front: ¿Puedes llamar a tu madre también?
cards.back: Can you give your mother a call too?

cards.front: Dame un toque si necesitas ayuda.
cards.back: Give me a shout if you need any help.

cards.front: Avísanos cuando acabes, por favor.
cards.back: Give us a shout when you finish, please.

cards.front: Dame un toque la próxima vez que estés en la ciudad, ¿vale?
cards.back: Give me a shout next time you're in town, ok?

cards.front: No voy a ir a trabajar, porque no quiero contagiarles a todos mi resfriado.
cards.back: I'm not going to work, because I don't want to give everybody my cold.

cards.front: ¡No te acerques a mí, que me vas a contagiar tu resfriado!
cards.back: Don't come near me, or you'll give me your cold!

cards.front: No me acercaré a ti porque no te quiero contagiar mi resfriado.
cards.back: I won't come near you, because I don't want to give you my cold.

cards.front: ¿Me puedes llevar a casa?
cards.back: Can you please give me a lift home?

cards.front: No le lleves si no le conoces.
cards.back: Don't give him a ride if you don't know him.

cards.front: ¿Llevas a los niños al colegio en coche?
cards.back: Will you give the kids a ride to school?

cards.front: Paul nunca entrega sus deberes a tiempo.
cards.back: Paul never gives in his homework on time.

cards.front: Tienes que entregar tus informes mañana a las once en punto.
cards.back: You have to give in your reports tomorrow at 11 o'clock sharp.

cards.front: No puedo terminar las fichas antes de la fecha límite. ¿Las puedo entregar más tarde?
cards.back: I can't finish the worksheets before the deadline! Can I give them in later?

cards.front: Claro que puedo prestarte mis apuntes. ¿Cuándo me los devolverás?
cards.back: Of course you can borrow my notes. When will you give them back?

cards.front: ¿Qué ocurrirá si no devuelvo los libros de la biblioteca a tiempo?
cards.back: What will happen if I don't give back the library books on time?

cards.front: Siempre devuelvo lo que presto.
cards.back: I always give back everything I borrow.

cards.front: Nuestro profesor de matemáticas reparte muchas fichas todas las semanas.
cards.back: Our maths teacher gives out a lot of worksheets every week.

cards.front: A menudo veo a estudiantes en la calle que reparten folletos.
cards.back: I often see students on the street giving out leaflets.

cards.front: Van a repartir los exámenes al final del trimestre.
cards.back: They're going to give out the exams at the end of term.

cards.front: ¡Mira este folleto! Hay alguien que da clases de francés gratuitas.
cards.back: Look at this leaflet! There's someone who gives French classes for free.

cards.front: Tom da clases de piano a adolescentes de 14 a 17 años.
cards.back: Tom gives piano classes to teenagers aged 14-17.

cards.front: El próximo trimestre voy a dar clases de inglés a niños pequeños.
cards.back: Next term I'm going to give English classes to small children.

cards.front: Después de entregar mi ensayo, voy a devolver mis libros de la biblioteca.
cards.back: After giving my essay in, I'm going to give my library books back.

cards.front: La fecha tope para entregar los deberes es dos días después de que yo los distribuya.
cards.back: The deadline to give in the homework is two days after I give it out.

cards.front: Me encanta dar clases de danza a niños.
cards.back: I love to give dance classes to children.

cards.front: John se muda, así que le estoy echando una mano con las cajas.
cards.back: John's moving house so I'm giving him a hand with his boxes.

cards.front: Mi madre me está echando una mano con los niños mientras trabajo.
cards.back: My mother is giving me a hand with the kids while I work.

cards.front: ¿Me echas una mano con los deberes, por favor?
cards.back: Will you give me a hand with my homework, please?

cards.front: ¡No tienes que devolvérmelo! ¡Te lo estoy regalando!
cards.back: You don't have to give it back to me! I'm giving it to you!

cards.front: ¿Le vas a regalar a Hanna algo por el estreno de su casa?
cards.back: Are you giving Hanna a housewarming gift?

cards.front: Tu madre me va a regalar su anillo de bodas.
cards.back: Your mother is going to give me her wedding ring.

cards.front: Voy a donar mi ropa vieja a la caridad.
cards.back: I'm giving my old clothes to charity.

cards.front: ¿Vas a donar algo de dinero a la investigación contra el cáncer?
cards.back: Will you give any money to cancer research?

cards.front: ¡No daré dinero a esa causa!
cards.back: I won't give any money to that cause!

cards.front: Es importante donar sangre durante todo el año.
cards.back: It's important to give blood year round.

cards.front: ¿Donaste sangre de tu brazo izquierdo o de tu brazo derecho?
cards.back: Did you give blood from your left arm or from your right arm?

cards.front: Me siento débil cuando dono sangre.
cards.back: I feel faint when I give blood.

cards.front: ¡Estos vaqueros no ceden nada!
cards.back: These jeans won't give at all!

cards.front: No te preocupes si esos zapatos te aprietan; ya cederán.
cards.back: Don't worry if those shoes are tight; they'll give.

cards.front: El cuero suele ceder más que el plástico.
cards.back: Leather usually gives more than plastic.

cards.front: ¿Me da un kilo de patatas y un kilo de zanahorias, por favor?
cards.back: May I have a kilo of potatoes and a kilo of carrots, please?

cards.front: ¿Me da dos kilos de plátanos y un kilo de manzanas, por favor?
cards.back: May I have two kilos of bananas and a kilo of apples, please?

cards.front: Deme un kilo de peras y un kilo de cerezas, por favor.
cards.back: May I have a kilo of pears and a kilo of cherries, please?

cards.front: Lucía da una fiesta de cumpleaños este sábado.
cards.back: Lucia is throwing a birthday party this Saturday!

cards.front: Elena da una fiesta de inauguración este fin de semana.
cards.back: Elena is throwing a housewarming party this weekend.

cards.front: Claudia da una fiesta de disfraces este viernes.
cards.back: Claudia is throwing a fancy dress party this Friday.

cards.front: Dale las gracias a él por su ayuda.
cards.back: Thank him for his help.

cards.front: Dale los buenos días a tu profesor.
cards.back: Say good morning to your teacher.

cards.front: Dale las buenas noches a tu tía.
cards.back: Say good night to your aunt.

cards.front: ¿Qué dan en el cine esta tarde noche?
cards.back: What's on at the cinema this evening?

cards.front: ¿Qué dan por la tele esta noche?
cards.back: What's on TV tonight?

cards.front: ¿Qué dan en el teatro este fin de semana?
cards.back: What's on at the theatre this weekend?

cards.front: ¡Da brillo a tus zapatos antes de ir al teatro!
cards.back: Polish your shoes before you go to the theatre!

cards.front: Da brillo a la plata antes del banquete de esta tarde noche.
cards.back: Polish the silver before the banquet this evening.

cards.front: Da brillo a los muebles antes de irte.
cards.back: Polish the furniture before leaving.
